scope: Stock EXPLAIN without ANALYZE of the exact CREATE outer-attempt lookup; no production modification, native execution by reviewer, or performance qualification.
findings: The outer lookup has a nullable legacy fallback OR an explicitly selected private attempt. An added unconditional attempt-id equality is redundant only for the known nonnull private path; the legacy NULL path must remain outside any proposed rewrite.

runtime_object_attempt already has its id primary key and runtime_object_attempt_writer(writer_xid) index. Inspect actual Index Cond and Filter placement; do not assume a sequential scan or an absent index.

A committed public 1024-CREATE group creates real attempt-row update history, not necessarily 1024 attempt rows or established table bloat. Record actual relation size, row/statistics context, and index definitions.

Committed attempt rows have complete=true and final progress. They do not reproduce a live unfinished attempt. The proposed comparison can establish planner shape under selected parameters and statistics, not active-attempt behavior or query latency.
required_comparison: Extract and pin the installed original SELECT. Remove only the PL/pgSQL INTO STRICT assignment target to make a standalone SELECT; preserve every predicate and FOR UPDATE NOWAIT.

Use identical prepared parameter identities and exact SQL types in both variants: xid8 writer, oid actor, jsonb contexts/input/request, bytea source/documents, and uuid selected attempt. Do not replace the NULL/nonnull OR with a hand-simplified branch.
Use force_generic_plan locally for both variants and add only unconditional a.id=$selected_attempt to the second query with a nonnull selected attempt.

Retain exact captured stored sources, source/manifest hashes, query text, parameter provenance, relevant role/settings, statistics, and full plans. Owner access is diagnostic access, not proof of public authorization.
Keep original fixture workload and deadlines. If real fixture creation fails, report that failure; do not fabricate row states or relax limits to obtain a favorable plan.
Do not use ANALYZE execution, disable guards or indexes, force scan methods, or change production settings. Do not mark a completed attempt incomplete.
interpretation_limits: EXPLAIN without ANALYZE does not measure execution time, buffers, or cost attribution.
Forced generic planning does not prove the failing CI call used a generic plan.
A changed plan is a hypothesis for a separately reviewed implementation and original workload validation, not approval to alter the source query or claim a speedup.
